acceptanceCriteria.text: Provisioning records a canonical manifest/digest identity for the activated QEMU data closure.
Reconciliation verifies the activated required files against that identity, not only file presence/non-empty shape.
A modified firmware/data file is detected deterministically and cannot return `Satisfied`.
The recovery policy is explicit: fail closed or safely reprovision from the immutable artifact.
Regression coverage mutates an activated required data file and proves reconciliation detects the drift.

issue.title: fix: verify activated QEMU data closure during reconciliation
